{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}During the trip we come across a battered camp full of colorful and clearly hostile characters who do not welcome our presence. Their leader salutes us mockingly, thanking the Dragon for his love. Those gathered hesitantly raise their weapons and seem ready to attack us. What should we do?
Nascent Rebellion

Their leader salutes us mockingly, thanking Ursun for his love. Those gathered hesitantly raise their weapons and seem ready to attack us. What should we do?
Nascent Rebellion

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}During the trip we come across a battered camp full of colorful and clearly hostile characters who do not welcome our presence. Their leader salutes us mockingly, thanking the Maw for its blessings. Those gathered hesitantly raise their weapons and seem ready to attack us. What should we do?
Nascent Rebellion

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}During the trip we come across a battered camp full of colorful and clearly hostile characters who do not welcome our presence. Their leader salutes us mockingly, thanking the gods of Chaos for their power. Those gathered hesitantly raise their weapons and seem ready to attack us. What should we do?
Nascent Rebellion

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}The smell of gunpowder hangs vaguely in the air, and even though the road seems relatively empty, the soldiers feel they are being watched. As the vanguard advances, a suspicious call of birds is heard. Should we continue down this path?
Bandits!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}The army crosses a thick forest, dark and humid. The horses are restless, and every noise sounds like a footstep or a whisper. The trees move as if they were alive before our eyes. The first regiment raises its lances in a defensive position. They say they heard whispers in the trees, and advise preparing for a possible ambush. Should we continue down this path?
Bandits!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}Horses and chariots can be heard in the distance, and they seem to surround the long line of the army on every side. Crazed screams and curses in a crude, guttural tongue ring out, though no one shows themselves in front of the army. They seem to be followers of the Dark Gods who want a toll from us to let us through. What should we do?
Bandits!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}The cackle of hobgoblins fills the night air, coming from every shadow around us. We see the slavers circling our encampment, testing whether it can be easily assaulted. They seem sloppy and overconfident. What should we do?
Bandits!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}Our advance party reports a large group of invaders in the distance. They are pushing into territory our empire has an interest in, looting small towns and stealing resources. Corpses riddled with arrows lie everywhere. Some survivors, deliberately left alive, tell the general it was "for the good of all". The invaders seem to want to settle the territory or, if they cannot take it, plunder it.
Raid!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}Our advance party reports a large group of invaders in the distance. They are pushing into territory our empire has an interest in, looting small towns and stealing resources. Half-eaten corpses and trampled houses are everywhere. Some survivors, deliberately left alive, babble to the general about "dinosaurs" and lizardmen. The invaders seem to want to settle the territory or, if they cannot take it, plunder it.
Raid!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}Our advance party reports a large group of invaders in the distance. They are pushing into territory our empire has an interest in, looting small towns and stealing resources. No corpses are seen anywhere. Most of the towns seem abandoned, with traces of sea water where there should be none. The use of magic here is clearly felt. The invaders seem to want to settle the territory or, if they cannot take it, plunder it.
Raid!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}The forest seems to shine under the light of Morrslieb as the army passes through. The night sounds feel too vivid and slow, and guttural noises are heard along the outer edges of the columns. A huge beast assaults the outer column and is driven off by the unit's attacks. The soldiers ask their general for a quick reaction. What should we do?
Possible Ambush?

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}The road winds through a pass between the mountains. Small caves surround the path and the silence feels heavy and ominous. The outer columns warn of red eyes in the dark, and the chattering is too loud to come from ordinary rats. The soldiers of the vanguard advise attacking the caves before they attack us! What should we do?
Possible Ambush?

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}A huge and powerful greenskin horde gathers at the top of the hill. They seem to be waiting for our army to stop so they can attack us. Shall we try our luck?
An Epic Battle!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}A huge and powerful army of dark elf slavers makes camp in an inaccessible area of this province. They clearly mean to raid the cities of our empire for slaves. The difficult terrain has played a trick on them and they have not noticed our presence. Should we try to intercept them?
An Epic Battle!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}Locals report that a legendary necromancer is hiding in a remote, ancient graveyard. Apparently he is raising his forces for an attack on our empire. If he is not intercepted, he may become a real threat to us. Should we attack him before he gets out of control?
An Epic Battle!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}Our advance party claims to have seen a unique sight under the green light of Morrslieb. Skeletons dressed in rich and beautiful clothes, with great constructs that move as if alive, are chasing a long band of Norscan marauders. When they spot us, they do not want to be stopped, and a large contingent turns towards us in case we think of attacking.
An Epic Battle!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}The legendary duo stands before us with a huge band of Slayers. They seem to have been sent on a suicide mission to destroy us, and they chase us on their short legs no matter how much distance we put between us. Why are we in the dwarfs' Book of Grudges?
An Epic Battle!
A Gift From Chaos

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}"SKARBRAND HATES YOU!" the Bloodthirster bellows. You feel his crushing strength just by looking at his imposing figure. "KHORNE SENT ME TO MEASURE YOU! HONOR KHORNE! PREPARE TO DIE!" The gaze of the god of war rests on you. The desire to fight embraces you and your blood boils and urges you. Embrace the challenge!
A Gift From Chaos

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}Khorne's consort towers over you like a corrupt and terrible angel. "Khorne calls you to serve his glory! I will be the one to test you! I will be the one to decide if you are worthy to worship our lord! Die and let me decorate his throne with your skull!" The gaze of the god of war rests on you. The desire to fight embraces you and your blood boils and urges you. Embrace the challenge!
A Gift From Chaos

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}In dreams, a fiery-eyed warrior directs you to a hidden clearing near your camp. You wake up with a strange fury and feel compelled to seek out the place from your dream. Guided by its vivid memory, you lead your army there. A greater daemon and his army are surprised by your arrival. "Who dares challenge the will of the Dark Master? Prepare to die." The mighty daemonic army prepares to attack. The gaze of the god of war rests on you. The desire to fight embraces you and your blood boils and urges you. Embrace the challenge!
A Gift From Chaos

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}A huge and swift daemon approaches you. You recognize him from the stories. Azazel looks at you almost fondly. "Little one, there is something strange about this sword." You feel compelled to listen. "I feel like she was once blessed by the Dark Prince, but now she has a nasty, violent aura. And she makes the dead come after me. Don't get me wrong, it's a lot of fun. But... I feel like if we fight here, I can get rid of her. What do you say? It's a fun idea, isn't it?" Azazel looks at you hopefully. You feel compelled to obey. The gaze of the god of war rests on you. The desire to fight embraces you and your blood boils and urges you. Embrace the challenge!
A Gift From Chaos

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}You find a sumptuous and openly debauched camp. It looks more like a carnival than a warrior enclave. The general of this army is of an angelic beauty. Sigvald the Magnificent gazes at you and speaks with arrogance: "My god sometimes surprises me when he presents me with horrible, unpresentable things like you." He makes a scornful gesture, but continues his monologue. "He sent me to give you a gift so that you would consider joining us. But seeing you here, so pathetic and weak, I have decided to keep it. You are clearly undeserving of his favor." The sweet and terrible gaze of the Dark Prince rests on you. The greed and debauchery of your heart compels you to take from the emissary what is justly yours. Embrace the temptation!
A Gift From Chaos

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}You find a strange, magnificent castle, clearly magical and decadent. It seems to be a manifestation of Chaos. You and your army feel compelled to enter. Orgies, sounds of pleasure and fountains of food and wine appear before your eyes. The legendary, terrible and beautiful daemon N'Kari welcomes you. "Nice to have you here. Do you feel her gaze? She makes me feel... wild. She wants to see you and me fight. I promise if you win I'll make it count for you." The daemon licks his lips with a long, lascivious tongue. "And if you lose, well, we'll still have fun... as much as possible." The daemon laughs. The sweet and terrible gaze of the Dark Prince rests on you. The greed and wildness of your heart compels you to accept his challenge. Embrace the temptation!
A Gift From Chaos

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}In the depth of the night the lookouts begin to scream, and some are killed amid desperate cries. They wake you up and put the camp on alert. An emissary approaches. A stunningly beautiful dark elf appears before you. "The Dark Prince wants me to present you with a gift. It seems that he has chosen you as his protégé. But I can always get a better deal if I kidnap you instead of giving you his gift." The elf looks at you with a calculating gaze. "I'll give you a chance to disappear. He's never liked cowards, so if he sees you running away I can just take his gift. Make a decision or die." The sweet and terrible gaze of the Dark Prince rests on you. The greed and wantonness of your heart compels you to destroy the emissary and her army. Embrace the temptation!
A Great Caravan Passes

A huge caravan of men from the east, about three armies strong, crosses our army's path. They seem heavily armed and prepared to battle any trouble that comes their way. Whatever they carry must be very valuable. The chance to take it may be worth the risk. Should we attack them?
A Great Caravan Passes

In the middle of the night, our scouts spot a long caravan of Chaos Dwarfs. It seems they are bringing a strong contingent of weapons and warriors to our enemies. Although the battle would probably be very difficult, we could turn this potential disaster into an opportunity.
This smithy is in the hands of our enemies. We can try to take it for our kingdom, opening its forge to our generals and heroes. Should we take it?
Reclaiming The Smithy

An enemy army approaches the smithy. The blacksmiths arm themselves with the weapons they have made, and the detachment of soldiers prepares for battle. Protecting the smithy is our duty. It must not fall into enemy hands.
Defending The Smithy

The master blacksmith looks at us anxiously. He looks at his works and asks us to choose one of them. The quality is clearly poor but it will still serve us for our army. Or we could give him a budget to expand the smithy so that it pays taxes faster and improve the quality of the equipment created upong visiting.\\n
The Master Blacksmith's Offer

The master blacksmith looks at us seriously. He looks at his works and asks us to choose one of them. The quality is clearly good and it will serve us for our army. Or we could give him a budget to expand the smithy so that it pays taxes faster and improve the quality of the equipment created upong visiting.\\n
The Master Blacksmith's Trust
The master blacksmith smiles. He looks at his masterpieces and asks you to choose one of them. The quality is clearly excellent and will serve us well in our military.
The Master Blacksmith's Gift
A Test of Arms

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}A rival general blocks the road with a modest force and calls out a challenge. They want to see whether our army is worth fearing. Do we accept?
Nascent Rebellion

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}We come across a battered camp full of armed malcontents who clearly do not welcome our presence. Their leaders shout for blood, and the mob raises its weapons. What should we do?
Bandits!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}The road ahead is too quiet. Fresh hoofprints cross it in every direction, and the scouts swear riders are shadowing the column from the tree line. Should we continue down this path?
Possible Ambush?

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}The column stretches thin through broken ground. Too many birds take flight at once, and the rearguard reports shapes moving along the ridges. The soldiers look to their general. What should we do?
Raid!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}Our advance party reports a large foreign force in the distance, looting small towns and carting off everything of value. The survivors say the invaders mean to take this land or strip it bare. What should we do?
An Epic Battle!

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}A great army waits in battle lines on the far side of the field, banners raised and war drums pounding. Its general has chosen this ground and expects us to answer. Shall we try our luck?
The Master Blacksmith's Forge

The master blacksmith shows us what the forge has on hand. We may take one piece freely while the forge is ready, commission a masterwork for gold, or pay to improve the forge so its work grows finer.
The Master Blacksmith's Forge

The Master Blacksmith's Forge

The Master Blacksmith's Forge

The master blacksmith shows us what the forge has on hand.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Forge level 3 of 3[[/col]]\\n- Free pieces: [[col:yellow]]rare[[/col]], one per visit\\n- Ready again: after the [[col:yellow]]Smithy cooldown[[/col]] once a free piece is taken (5 turns by default)\\n- Commission: two rare masterworks for [[col:yellow]]15,000[[/col]] gold\\n- Tribute: one item every [[col:yellow]]5 turns[[/col]]\\n- Unique commission: one unique piece for [[col:yellow]]20,000[[/col]] gold
The Ancient Tower

An ancient tower rises before us, its gates held by a hostile warband. Five floors lead up to the Master of the Tower, and every floor we take adds to the haul.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Floors[[/col]]\\n- Floor 1: easy\\n- Floors 2 to 4: medium\\n- Floor 5: the Master of the Tower, hard\\n\\nAfter each victory we may climb higher or leave with the haul. Our losses carry over from floor to floor. [[col:red]]Losing any floor forfeits the whole haul.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Between floors[[/col]]\\nAfter each victory the tower offers deals for the climb ahead: healing, buffs, sabotage, gambles and more. [[col:yellow]]Missions[[/col]] set a goal for the next battle and pay only if we fight that battle ourselves. [[col:red]]An auto-resolved battle does not count.[[/col]]
The Master Has Fallen

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_tower_result_floor_5").StringValue}}The Master of the Tower lies dead at our feet, and every floor is ours. Its vaults stand open.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]The climb[[/col]]\\n{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_tower_climb_floor_5").StringValue}}\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]The whole haul is ours to claim.[[/col]]
Tower Floor 1 Cleared

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_tower_result_floor_1").StringValue}}The floor is ours, and the way up lies open. Our army has had no time to recover.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]The climb[[/col]]\\n{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_tower_climb_floor_1").StringValue}}\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Floor 2 adds to the haul[[/col]]\\n- 2000 gold, up to 3000 for a clean win\\n- 2 uncommon or rare items\\n\\nClimb higher for a richer haul, or leave now and keep what we have. [[col:red]]An auto-resolved battle does not count.[[/col]]
An Ally Beset

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}Smoke rises beyond the next ridge, where an allied army stands surrounded. Their lines are bending, and the enemy brought far more warriors than it needs. If we march now, we can fight at their side and turn the day. Win, and their kin across these lands will remember who came to help.
Turn the Tables

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}The scouts of our allied escort come back at a run: an enemy war party lies hidden along the road ahead, waiting for us to walk into its trap. They do not know they have been seen. If we strike first, together, the hunters become the hunted. Win, and the escort's kin will hear of it.
Relief Column

{{CcoCampaignEventDilemma:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_battle_missions").StringValue}}A rider reaches us half dead: an allied army is cut off, and the enemy is closing in for the kill. They will not hold for long. If we march hard, we can reach them before their line breaks, and some of those we save may choose to fight under our banner.
The Tavern

Smoke, song and the smell of spilled drink fill the common room. Sellswords trade rumours by the fire, a notice board sags under old contracts, and the keeper keeps the good barrels behind the bar.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Tavern level 1 of 3[[/col]]\\n- The contract board opens in a later update.\\n- Only the owner can improve the tavern.
The Tavern

The tavern has grown: a second hall for the sellswords, more beds upstairs and a busier notice board. Word of it travels with every caravan that stops here.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Tavern level 2 of 3[[/col]]\\n- The contract board opens in a later update.\\n- Only the owner can improve the tavern.
The Tavern

The tavern is known far and wide. Famous companies drink in its halls, its board carries the richest contracts in the land, and its cellars hold brews found nowhere else.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Tavern level 3 of 3[[/col]]\\n- The contract board opens in a later update.\\n- Only the owner can improve the tavern.
A Tavern in Enemy Hands

This tavern is held by our enemies, and its keeper has hired blades to guard the door. We can storm it and take it for ourselves, though a grander tavern keeps tougher guards.\\n\\nWin the battle and the tavern is ours. Lose, and it stays in enemy hands.
Hidden Tomb

A forgotten tomb lies half-buried in the hillside, its door split by roots and time. The wards carved into the stone are old, but not all of them have failed, and something inside still remembers how to bite.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Abandoned Camp

Cold fires and empty tents stand in a sheltered hollow. Whoever camped here left in a hurry, and left dry bedding, full stores and a fair share of loot behind them.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Buried Relics

Bones of something enormous jut from the churned earth. Among them lie older things, weapons and charms buried long before the beast ever died here.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Hidden Temple

A temple untouched by time rises from the wilds, its altar swept clean as if by unseen hands. Its keepers are long gone, but the power that drew them here is not.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Caravan Remnants

A half-sacked caravan lies across the road, its wagons overturned and its goods scattered in the mud. The raiders were in a hurry, and they missed more than they took.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Whispers of Our God

Our lord wakes from a dream more vivid than any waking hour. A voice spoke in it, offering strength for the trials ahead, and some of its gifts come with a price.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
The Explorer
A band of weathered explorers shares our fire for the night. They trade maps and tales of the road ahead, and ask only for safe passage in return.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Legendary Bard

A famous bard sits in chains in a bandit camp we have just put to flight. Freed, they promise to sing of our deeds in every hall and war camp across the land.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Ruined Shrine
A burnt-out shrine still hums with an old and patient power. Offerings left here may be answered with a blessing, or with something far less kind.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Smugglers' Cache

Crates and barrels lie hidden under a false floor, and their owners watch us from the treeline. They deal in goods, in favours and in secrets, and they are open to offers.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Beast Lair
Something big lives in this cave. The bones scattered outside are fresh, the tracks are deep, and the stench carries on the wind for a mile.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Old Battlefield

Crows wheel over an old battlefield where two armies broke each other long ago. Shattered engines, lost banners and unburied bones still lie in the mud.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Witch's Hut

A crooked hut squats in the marsh, thick with smoke and stranger smells. The witch who lives here trades in gambles, pacts and curses, and she always collects.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Collapsed Mine

A collapsed mine yawns in the hillside, its lower galleries half-flooded. The deeper tunnels are still rich, and still deadly to anyone who lingers.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Merchant's Wagon
A travelling merchant has lost the road and most of their escort. Far from any market and glad of any customer, they throw open their wagon to us.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Sunken Library

A library has sunk into the marsh, its shelves rotting in black water. Some scrolls survive, sealed in wax and lead, holding the secrets of other realms.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
Spoils of War
The field is ours, and the enemy flees or lies still. Before we march on, there is more to take from this victory.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or walk away.[[/col]]
The Bar

The keeper leans on the bar beside barrels for every taste, while strangers roll dice at the tables and a hulking champion waits for anyone brave enough to lock arms with them. What will it be?\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Choose one, or go back to the common room.[[/col]]
The Mercenary Hall

Sellswords of every stripe drink and dice in the back hall, waiting for a lord with coin. The companies here are for hire to every visitor at 1000 gold over their usual cost, and new ones arrive every 5 turns.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Hire up to 2, after which the hall will not deal with us for 5 turns, or go back to the common room.[[/col]]
